name: bright-cartoon
summary: A clear, bright cartoon starter picture: lights, sky, fog, cel materials, ground, water and a few props, all in code. Copy it, then change it.
use: threedog lib pull bright-cartoon --force in a new game (it replaces the gray starter files in picture/); main.js keeps its engine.use(createPicture()) line. Shapes take picture.materials.<name>; read the notes at the top of picture/index.js first.
usage:
@ts-check
Ground: one mesh from your own height function. pathAt() paints paths into a vertex value, and the patch field cuts that value into a clean, wobbling
edge. Why not a texture: a mask stored per vertex costs nothing, stays sharp up close, and the game's level code already knows where the paths are.
A sharper or thinner path needs more segments.
